description.narrative: The Department for Green Diplomacy and Climate (KLIMA) has a portfolio of approximately 200 open engagements, which in most cases requires yearly financial accounting. The Ministry has had an increased focus on ensuring that financial statements are thoroughly reviewed and approved within a period of 18 months from the ‘due date’, i.e. the deadline for receiving them from respective partners. If financial statements from partners are either not received, reviewed or approved within the 18-month period they are marked as very old (‘GRO’) indicating a specific risk and challenge in reference to compliance. KLIMA has as of January 2026 approximately 5 of these specific engagements with old outstanding financial statements. The number is expected to increase as of July 2026 when a number of accounts become GRO. KLIMA has had a continuous backlog in terms of completion of older engagements. As of July 2026, the number of financial statements which will be due for review and/or not approved is approximately 120
